title: ID0403226-DC/Si-D/TR-[multi] QR Code Problem
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
QR Code Problem
Root cause:
Solution:
Updated FW
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Warranty Status: Active
A customer has reported an issue where the QR code on some devices cannot be scanned via the mobile application.
We have experienced the same issue with the newly commissioned Charger ID: 5lAFgO. As seen in the attached video, the customer's mobile application fails to read the QR code displayed on the device screen. However, when the same QR code is generated on a computer, it can be scanned without any issues.
We kindly request your support on this matter.
15-QR.mp4
